newsitem.title: UK: Turkey tenders to buy 50kt low sulphur fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Turkey tenders to buy 50kt low sulphur fuel oil.

text.p: Turkey's state oil company Tupras has tendered to buy 50,000 tonnes of low sulphur fuel oil for late February delivery, traders said on Monday.
Tupras requires one 50,000 tonne cargo of fuel oil containing a maximum of one percent sulphur, to be delivered between February 20 and 25.
Traders also said they had heard that an earlier Syrian tender to sell 100,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil in February had been cancelled. But the cancellation could not immediately be confirmed.
